episodes.name: An uneasy feeling

episodes.name: Game battle with Emiri
episodes.plot: Rilakkuma has lots of fun playing video games with a new friend, but the big fuzzy bear gets a little dizzy after playing too much. Next stop: teacups!

episodes.name: Eiji and the jungle tour
episodes.plot: Kiiroitori ends up getting stuck in a tree. Can Rilakkuma and friends rescue the little bird? Kaoru and Korilakkuma finally make it into the park.

title.value: L’avventura di Rilakkuma al parco dei divertimenti

overview.value: Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma, Kiiroitori, and Kaoru are off on an adventure to the theme park, but with closing time imminent it leads to a series of fun mishaps and incidents as the group squeeze a day of fun into tiny amount of time.

translations.title: L’avventura di Rilakkuma al parco dei divertimenti
Rilakkuma's Theme Park Adventure
translations.overview: Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma, Kiiroitori, and Kaoru are off on an adventure to the theme park, but with closing time imminent it leads to a series of fun mishaps and incidents as the group squeeze a day of fun into tiny amount of time.

translations.title: リラックマと遊園地
translations.overview: リラックマたちが遊びにでかけた閉園間近の遊園地で巻き起こる事件とそれをめぐる人々との出会いのアクティブな一日を濃密に描くノンストップな本作。「リラックマとカオルさん」でお馴染みのキャラクターたちももちろん、本作は個性豊かな新キャラも多数登場！
